title: 第741章 四阶法宝随便送大师姐的死亡凝视第740章 跨界火锅局三女同台老祖只能啃骨头
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
青阳宗，明月峰主峰洞府。
灵气浓郁凝结成乳白色的雾气，缭绕在白玉门槛四周。
林渊与慕云汐并肩踏入，一股浑厚如渊的元婴威压盘旋在穹顶。
两人齐齐见礼。
“师尊！”
明月真君端坐在主位上，周身萦绕着元婴威压。
她目光在两人身上转了一圈，嘴角勾起轻笑：
“你们两个，今日怎么舍得来为师这里？”
林渊上前一步，神色郑重：
“师尊，我与师姐打算前往妖域和海域深处历练一番，特来辞行。”
明月真君眉头微蹙，看向慕云汐：
“林渊这小子喜欢在逆境中折腾也就罢了。
“可云汐你极少外出历练，妖域和海域凶险万分，一旦遇到高阶妖兽，可不是闹着玩的。”
慕云汐神色清冷，语气异常坚定：
“师尊，温室里的花朵经不起风雨。
“唯有历经生死搏杀，才能真正感悟大道。
“我想与师弟并肩前行，绝不想被他甩在身后。”
听到这话，明月真君定定看了她一眼。
良久，她轻叹一声：
“罢了，雏鹰总要展翅。

“你想去，便去吧。”
说罢，她素手一挥。
虚空微微震颤。
三枚巴掌大小的白玉符箓凭空浮现，稳稳悬停在两人面前。
“此乃婴剑符，是我耗费元婴本源之力绘制的保命底牌。”
明月真君语气肃然：
“激发之后，元婴之下皆可斩。
“即便是普通的元婴初期修士，也能将其重创。”
林渊心中涌起暖意。
耗费元婴本源之力绘制灵符，意味着师尊需要闭关数月才能恢复。
这份护短之情，重若千钧。
明月真君看着他们，语气加重：
“历练固然重要，但命更重要，切记！”
“谨遵师命！”
两人齐声应道，将玉符郑重收起。
明月真君目光转向林渊，语气中透着严厉：
“林渊，我知道你主意多。
“你师姐实战经验不足，你务必护她周全。”
“师尊放心，弟子定当舍命相护！”
离开主峰，两人径直来到了秦婉如的洞府。

洞府内，秦婉如一袭水蓝色长裙，慵懒地斜倚在软榻上。
她手里把玩着一只白玉茶盏。
二师姐苏知秋和三师姐叶轻寒恰好也在。
“哟，你们两个现在是连掩饰都不掩饰了，天天出双入对的。”
content_en:
Qingyang Sect, the main peak cave of Mingyue Peak.
The rich spiritual energy condensed into a milky white mist, lingering around the white jade threshold.
Lin Yuan and Mu Yunxi stepped in side by side, and a Yuanying pressure as thick as the abyss hovered on the dome.
The two of them bowed in unison.
"Master!"
True Lord Mingyue sat on the main seat, surrounded by the pressure of Nascent Soul.
She looked around the two of them and chuckled at the corner of her mouth:
"How come you two are willing to come here as a teacher today?"
Lin Yuan took a step forward with a solemn expression:
"Master, my senior sister and I plan to go to the Demon Realm and the depths of the sea for some experience, so we came here to say goodbye."
True Lord Mingyue frowned slightly and looked at Mu Yunxi:
"This kid Lin Yuan just likes to toss in adversity.
"But Yun tide, you rarely go out for training. The demon realm and the sea are extremely dangerous. Once you encounter a high-level demon beast, it is no joke. "
Mu Yunxi's expression was cold and her tone was extremely firm:
"Master, the flowers in the greenhouse cannot withstand the wind and rain.
“Only through life-and-death struggle can one truly understand the great path.
“I want to move forward side by side with my junior brother, and never want to be left behind by him. "
Hearing this, Lord Mingyue gave her a fixed look.
After a long time, she sighed softly:
"Forget it, the young eagle always spreads its wings.
"If you want to go, just go."
After saying that, she waved her hand.
The void trembled slightly.
Three palm-sized white jade talismans appeared out of thin air and hovered steadily in front of the two of them.
"This is the Infant Sword Talisman. It is a life-saving trump card that I drew using the original power of the Nascent Soul."
True Lord Mingyue said in a solemn tone:
"After being activated, anyone under the Nascent Soul can be killed.
“Even an ordinary early-stage Nascent Soul cultivator can severely injure him. "
Lin Yuan felt warm in his heart.
Spending the original power of the Nascent Soul to draw the talisman means that the master needs to be in seclusion for several months to recover.
This feeling of protecting one's shortcomings is as important as a thousand stones.
True Lord Mingyue looked at them and his tone became more serious:
“Experience is important, but life is more important, remember! "
"I will obey my master's orders! "
The two of them responded in unison and solemnly put away the jade talisman.
True Lord Mingyue turned his eyes to Lin Yuan, with a stern tone in his tone:
"Lin Yuan, I know you have many ideas.
"Your senior sister has little actual combat experience, so you must protect her thoroughly."
"Master, don't worry, my disciples will risk their lives to protect each other!"
Leaving the main peak, the two went straight to Qin Wanru's cave.
In the cave, Qin Wanru was wearing a long aqua dress, leaning lazily on the soft couch.
She was playing with a white jade teacup in her hand.
Second senior sister Su Zhiqiu and third senior sister Ye Qinghan happened to be there too.
"Hey, you two don't even try to hide it now. You are in love with each other every day."
